atomic_facts.fact: The bankruptcy filing was made under Swedish law
The bankruptcy filing was made in Stockholm
The bankruptcy filing occurred on March 12, 2025
Tesla did not acquire any of Northvolt's Swedish manufacturing plants
Lyten acquired Northvolt Ett in Skellefteå, Sweden
Lyten acquired Ett Expansion in Skellefteå, Sweden
Lyten acquired Northvolt Labs in Västerås, Sweden
Lyten completed the acquisition of the Swedish assets in February 2026
Northvolt Ett is set to resume operations following Lyten's acquisition
Northvolt Labs is set to resume operations following Lyten's acquisition
Commercially produced battery cells from the Skellefteå factory are expected in the second half of 2026
